headline: Denj Lane House / Carter Williamson Architects
context: Located in Sydney's Inner West, Denj Lane introduces a studio and garage, created for a young family seeking flexible space for work, guests and the future. Compact in footprint yet complete in function, the studio contains a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen and living area.
